reviews.review_title: Review at Moo Beef Steak - Prime
reviews.review_text:
Andre Nguyen
8 contributions
0
Worst Steakhouse in Saigon!
Dec 2024 • Couples
As an Australian Tourist, this has been the most expensive, yet worst steakhouse I have tried in Saigon. I have tried Elsol, BepBo, El Gaucho, 48 Bistro, and this has easily been my worst experience.

STEAK:

I ordered the Australian Signature Black Angus Tenderloin 400g, MEDIUM RARE, face valued ~ 1,800,000VND (~120AUD), before 50% discount on mondays.

First serve was horrendously over cooked (image 1), with the exterior burnt. The steak tasted like a piece of rubber.

The manager told us the kitchen will cook me a new steak. When it arrived, it was now extremely under cooked, to the point of being rare/blue (image 2). I then had to send it back yet again…

When the steak arrived again, after being reheated, the middle was medium rare (image 3), however the edge was still extremely over cooked (image 4).

FRIES:

The fries were horrible. Wiggly cut chips, something you’d serve a child not a high end restaurant.

The were extremely dry and hard on the outside, and undercooked on the inside. Fries are supposed to be crunchy, yet fluffy. When biting into the fries, you could still crunch on the potato, thats how undercooked it was.

Service and my experience:

As a high end steak house, it is extremely disappointing how the chef here is unable to evenly cook a steak.

Even after the 50% promotion, i do not feel it is worth any value. I would not even come back if it was free of cost.

Moreover, the staff here do not give off welcoming or warm vibes, they answered in a very condescending tone when I asked questions such as “does the steak come with sauce or sides”, as if it was a stupid question.

Even after the multiple complaints and multiple send back, I did not receive any compensation for other than free fries (which were horrible) for this terrible experience. When presented the bill by the manager, he did not even bother to tell me that the fries were compensated, i had to look at the receipt to find out myself. He did not even bother to make sure I was happy or how I felt about the dinner. Not even a single apology. The level of service needs to improve drastically.

New and Delicious Salad
May 2024 • Business
I have dined several times at Moo Beef Steak Prime, a beef specialty restaurant on Ngo Duc Ke Street in Saigon, and the quality is excellent. This time, they have a new and very special salad dish called Smoked Burrata, so I wanted to share it with everyone. Smoked Burrata is combined with various colored cherry tomatoes. The cherry tomatoes are blanched, peeled, and then soaked in a mixture of sauce with sugar, sake, mirin, fennel, and some herbs. After about 2-3 days, the tomatoes absorb the flavors, making them taste sweeter and more fragrant. The Burrata is served with fresh lettuce, marinated tomatoes, coffee jelly, toasted almonds, and smoked Burrata cheese. The smoking process gives the cheese a light smoky flavor. It was so delicious that I ate it all and forgot to take pictures.
